business_summary: Suzhou Shijing Environmental Technology Co.,Ltd. engages in research and development, manufactures, and sells pollution detection and environmental protection equipment in China and internationally. The company offers purification, exhaust gas integrated treatment system, photocatalytic system, organic system, silane system, deodorizing organic purification tower, plasma organic exhaust gas purifier, recycling system, adsorption desorption, rubber industry vacuum vulcanizer exhaust treatment system, and regenerative thermal incinerator. It also provides dust collection products, such as sintered board dust collector, grinding and cleaning the dust collection system, sand treatment dust collection system, falling sand dust collection system, explosion-proof dust collector, pulsating filter cartridge dust collector, pulsating filter bag dust collector, mine ore processing dust collection series, rolling mill converter dust collecting system, crane passing dust collection system, rotary dust cover, and AOD LU dust collectors; and pulse dust collector, casting sand production line dust removal system. In addition, the company offers CID gasification system, nitrogen oxide gas generation system, automobile manufacturing gas generation system, silane system, acid-base system, manual pickling line NOX purification equipment system, high-temperature pickling line NOX purification equipment system, nitrogen oxide treatment unit, and deodorizing scrubber; and liquid catalyst plus dry desulfurization, LCR purification, NID semi-dry flue gas desulfurization technology, denitration technology, desulfurization technology, circulating fluidized bed semi-dry flue gas desulfurization technology. The company was formerly known as Suzhou Shijing Environmental Protection Equipment Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Suzhou Shijing Environmental Technology Co.,Ltd. in October 2015. Suzhou Shijing Environmental Technology Co.,Ltd. was founded in 2005 and is based in Suzhou, China.
business_summary_ko: 소주 Shijing 환경 기술 유한 회사 중국 및 국제적으로 오염 감지 및 환경 보호 장비의 연구 개발, 제조 및 판매에 참여하고 있습니다. 이 회사는 정화, 배기가스 통합 처리 시스템, 광촉매 시스템, 유기 시스템, 실란 시스템, 탈취 유기 정화탑, 플라즈마 유기 배기 가스 정화기, 재활용 시스템, 흡착 탈착, 고무 산업 진공 가황 배기 처리 시스템 및 축열식 소각로를 제공합니다. 또한 소결판 집진기, 집진 시스템 연삭 및 청소, 모래 처리 집진 시스템, 낙하 모래 집진 시스템, 방폭 집진기, 맥동 필터 카트리지 집진기, 맥동 필터 백 집진기, 광산 광석 처리 집진 시리즈, 압연기 변환기 집진 시스템, 크레인 통과 집진 시스템, 회전 집진 커버 및 AOD LU 집진기와 같은 집진 제품을 제공합니다. 펄스 집진기, 주조사 생산 라인 먼지 제거 시스템. 또한 회사는 CID 가스화 시스템, 질소산화물 가스 생성 시스템을 제공합니다.
